# BoundingBox

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Calculate the geographic bounds of your points (with lat/lng keys) or GeoJSON and get a camera position (center, zoom) that fits them all in view.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/bounding-box",
  "type": "BoundingBoxOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/bounding-box').par.data` (an input) and `op('/bounding-box').out.bounds` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.data`, `out.bounds`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `data` | `ArrayField` | `[]` |
| `padding` | `NumberField` | `0` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|

| `longitude` | `NumberField` |
| `latitude` | `NumberField` |
| `zoom` | `NumberField` |
| `viewState` | `CompoundPropsField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
